decision: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
event_name: Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda Document 24 Date 10 June 2018 Time 12:51 2018 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 7 - 10 June 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 23), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 4th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 4th Turbo Charger (TC), 4th Motor Generator Unit Heat (MGU-H) and a 3rd Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K) have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Articles 23.3 a) and 23.3 b). The team notified the Technical Delegate regarding the change of the power unit elements on the 9th June, at 19:50. Gerd Ennser Jose Abed Emanuele Pirro Paul Cooke
title: 2018 Canadian Grand Prix Offence Car 10 Power Unit Elements24
